$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFJE (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Motte-Chalancon

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Altiport reserved for licensed pilots: for airplane pilots, either a mountain qualification (wheels and/or skis), or a valid altiport access permit.; ULM pilots are strongly advised to have taken the mountain course organized by the FFPLUM.
Commercial air transport is prohibited, except discovery flights.
AD available for HEL and ULM.
Possible presence of vultures near the high altitude airport (breeding in the vicinity).
Caution advised: when northern or southern wind > 15 kt (strong turbulences),; Northbound DEP when northern wind > 15 kt and/or heavy load and high temperature (down-draught, low climb).
High part of the RWY pebbled.
Corner marks at the bottom of the runway less than the width of the runway.
Due to noise pollution, training sessions are kept to a strict minimum.
Arrivals: ARR from the North: abeam East of CHALANCON (NW).
ARR from the South: CORNILLON SUR OULE lake (S) then follow the circuits drawn on the chart.
No parking in take-off line position.
Do not park in front of the hangar.
